question: The number of prime numbers between 308 and 320 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Check numbers between 308 and 320

309, 310, 311, 312, 313, 314, 315, 316, 317, 318, 319

Primes: 311, 313, 317

**∴ Answer = 3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers between 308 and 320

**Concept Used:**

Prime number = number divisible only by 1 and itself

**Calculation:**

⇒ Check each number:

309 = 3 × 103 ❌

310 = even ❌

311 = prime ✔

312 = even ❌

313 = prime ✔

314 = even ❌

315 = divisible by 3,5 ❌

316 = even ❌

317 = prime ✔

318 = even ❌

319 = 11 × 29 ❌

**∴ Total primes = 3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Numbers
